name: AI for Public Servants
description: Use approved AI for public-service drafting and evidence work while keeping decisions, privacy, records and review authority explicit. Preserve and correct concrete source artifacts, carry six module outputs into a synthetic pilot recommendation, and practice trade-offs in six module Decision Labs plus a capstone simulation.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Government, Defense and Public Safety

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Public Servants

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Draft a constituent reply with an approved AI tool that removes unneeded PII, keeps Privacy Act and CUI data out of tools not covered for it, verifies every factual claim against the policy source, and identifies which prompts and outputs must be captured as records under NARA AC 11.2026 or a state public-records act
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Rewrite a public notice into plain language and translate it so that every legal condition and critical field (dates, amounts, deadlines) survives, verified by a condition checklist and back-translation
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Produce a public-comment summary, FOIA redaction pass or briefing memo in which every quote and citation traces to its source, seeded substantive comments or PII items are recalled, and the AI search prompts are documented for the case file
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Audit AI-extracted fields and virtual-agent transcripts in a benefits or contact-center queue, route errors and urgent contacts to a human, and write the appeal-trace note the FNS automation memo expects
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Decide, for a given task, whether AI output would be a principal basis for a benefits, employment or translation decision presumed high-impact under OMB M-25-21 section 6, and name the human review and appeal step that must remain
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Prepare procurement, hiring, minutes or permit documents with AI while keeping proposal data, applicant ranking, unapproved minutes and permit decisions out of the tool, and correct planted errors in an AI draft
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Design a measured pilot for one task in your own unit (baseline, accuracy or recall check, error and appeal rates) and write a one-page use-case note for your Chief AI Officer or IT office
